title: Quotation completeness and arithmetic
content: Required quotation fields must be present and declared totals must match deterministic calculations within the configured tolerance.

title: Discount approval authority
content: Discounts above ten percent require approval by an authorised human reviewer.

title: Restricted-party screening fixture
content: Every quotation must be screened against the approved restricted-party source. This Build Week fixture is simulated and is not a live sanctions list.

title: Foreign-trade and export authorisation
content: Controlled goods must not be released without a documented export licence or authorised release. Country and destination restrictions require current authoritative data in production.

title: Batch-pure delivery requirement
content: If batch-pure delivery is contractually required, supplier confirmation must be documented before release. Explicit inability to comply blocks the quotation.
